Kill [[Greves the Overbearing]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Greves the Overbearing]] in [[the Black Curtain (War in Kryta)|The Black Curtain]]
* *BONUS* Kill Greves the Overbearing in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 7 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 3 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
Exit south out of [[Temple of the Ages]] and make your way toward Greves the Overbearing. There are two groups of White Mantle close together, as well as some undead pop-ups. Try to pull the groups individually, as the undead plus the two groups of White Mantle could overwhelm your party. If you aggro too much, simply retreat a small distance toward Temple of the Ages, causing the farther white mantle group to lose aggro. Be sure to focus on the [[White Mantle Priest|priests]] and [[White Mantle Ritualist (ritualist)|ritualist]] enemies first as they will keep Greves the Overbearing healed.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"Greves the Overbearing has called for a crusade against the [[Temple of the Ages]], claiming the priests therein have murdered White Mantle forces and incited a holy war against his false gods. Queen Salma offers a bounty for any faithful Krytan who strikes down Greves before he can lure more innocent Krytans to his cause."''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Re-create this historical War in Kryta bounty quest. Greves the Overbearing called for a crusade against the Temple of The Ages and spread much misery among worshippers of the Old Gods during the White Mantle regime. Queen Salma offered a bounty for Greves the Overbearing, who met his doom in a fateful clash of steel and magic. Take up this famed quest once again and eliminate Greves to earn the royal bounty."''

;Princess Salma
:''"Thank you [Character Name], your efforts bring us one step closer to a unified nation."''

==Notes==
*Sometimes Greves the Overbearing may be killed by native foes, completing your quest before you get to him.
